name: ritual-habit-tracker
description: Ritual — local-first habit tracker, PWA and Android app.

scripts.android:add: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:open: npm run prepare:web && npx cap open android
